Team —

OptiLabs (fast-growing analytics startup) is asking for a slightly expanded pilot package: 90 days, $50k platform credits up front, and a 20% promotional discount on committed spend if they convert to a 12-month contract. They’ve signaled a strong desire to move quickly if procurement is satisfied.

Why I’m asking for approval: this exceeds my standard pilot concession authority and materially impacts committed credit burn and early ARR math. I’ve included a short list of reasons I think we should approve with conditions:
- High strategic fit: OptiLabs already integrates with our SDK and showed strong throughput in the POC.
- Conversion likelihood: product has shown interest in embedding our runtime; sales estimate ~65% conversion probability within 90 days.
- Competitive pressure: they’re talking to two other vendors and have a go-live timeline that favors whoever clears procurement quickly.

Proposed conditional approval (recommended):
- Approve up to $40k platform credits (instead of $50k) for a 90-day pilot.
- Promotional discount 15% on committed spend if they sign within 30 days after pilot completion.
- Require procurement to sign the DocuSign with our standard promo terms and a 12-month committed spend target of at least $200k ARR equivalent.

Attachments: optilabs_scope_of_work.pdf

Please advise — I can take this to legal and procurement once we have an amount to propose.

Thanks,
Monica

I ran the economics and attached a quick model (see attachment). High-level takeaways:
- $40k credits / 90-day pilot with a 65% conversion probability yields an expected first-year ARR of ~$130k (NPV at our discount).
